parent_models.justification: VGG16 is a specific variant within the VGG family of neural networks. Hence, VGG is a more general model category that encompasses VGG16, making it a parent model.
VGG16 is a convolutional neural network (CNN), so a 'cnn-based model' is a broad category that includes models like VGG16, VGG11, and VGG19.
This is a semantically similar category to 'cnn-based model' and also includes specific architectures like VGG16.

closest_parent_model.justification: VGG is the specific family of models within which VGG16 is a variant. While 'cnn-based model' is a broader category of neural networks, 'VGG' refers specifically to the family that directly includes VGG16.

child_models.justification: VGG11 is another specific variant in the VGG family, and while not strictly a child of VGG16 in a hierarchical sense, it is related as another member of the VGG family.
VGG19 is another specific variant in the VGG family, similar to VGG16 in this context, considered alongside VGG16.

closest_child_model.justification: VGG11 is structurally more similar to VGG16 than VGG19 due to having fewer layers, making it the closest child model in semantically comparable terms.

sibling_models.justification: VGG11 can be considered a sibling of VGG16 due to their shared VGG family context.
VGG19 can also be considered a sibling to VGG16 based on the shared architecture family.

closest_sibling_model.justification: VGG19, being similar in architecture with just a difference in depth (more layers than VGG16), is the closest sibling model.

unrelated_models.justification: Unrelated because it doesn't share architectural features with VGG models.
